subject: Milestone-anchored net terms & VAT evidence for Q2 pilot
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisupply.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena.p@medisupply.io>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Net terms request and VAT evidence for Q2 pilot

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week. We are keen to move the Q2 pilot forward but need to align on payment terms and VAT documentation before we can cut a PO. Two quick asks from our side:

1) Payment terms: Our procurement team prefers Net45 for new vendors during pilot programs to smooth cashflow across Q2. Can Redwood accept Net45 for the first two invoices and then re-evaluate for Net30 thereafter?

2) VAT/tax evidence: Because Medisupply will be the paying entity (US subsidiary), our tax team needs Redwood's tax residency certificate and a signed EU VAT reverse-charge statement (if applicable). Can you share the appropriate tax forms?

I've attached our Q1 usage forecast and expected invoice cap so you can size any credit cushion.

Attachment: MS-Statement-Q1-USD.pdf (pdf, 74KB)

Next steps: if you can confirm the conditional Net45 and provide the tax docs, I will request a PO and route the DocuSign SOW.

Best,
Oliver Grant
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
MediSupply
oliver.grant@medisupply.io
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisupply.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Net terms request and VAT evidence for Q2 pilot

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. We're happy to support the pilot with conditional Net45 for the initial invoices, with the following guardrails so we don't end up with runway risk for either side: 

- Structure: Net45 for invoices 1 and 2 (pilot kickoff + mid-pilot consumption). If usage is within the forecast and there are no delinquent payments, we move to Net30 for subsequent invoices.
- Deposit / credit cushion: We require either a 10% milestone deposit on invoice 1 or a prepaid credit cushion (USD 35k) applied against the pilot. Either option will allow Net45 while protecting service capacity.
- PO & SOW: We need a PO and a signed SOW (DocuSign) before the first invoice is issued. Please route the PO to finance@redwood.com.
- VAT evidence: attached is our Redwood Tax Residency form for your tax team to review. If reverse-charge applies in your EU entity flow, we'll sign the standard statement.

Attachment: Tax-Residency-Form.pdf (pdf, 22KB)
Related: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-REDWOOD-MEDISUPPLY-8421

Cc'ing Marcus (finance) and Laura (legal ops) to confirm the acceptable credit threshold and to expedite DocuSign. If Marcus confirms the cushion and Laura clears the SOW language, we'll be ready to issue invoice 1 on acceptance.

If helpful, here's a short bulleted mutual action plan:
- Oliver: confirm deposit vs prepaid credit and send PO (target: 48 hours)
- Redwood: prep DocuSign SOW and share final invoice schedule (within 24 hrs of PO)
- Both: exchange tax residency / VAT forms once DocuSign is in flight

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00

Irene — quick internal note on the credit/ops side.

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 11:05 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Deposit / credit cushion: We require either a 10% milestone deposit on invoice 1 or a prepaid credit cushion (USD 35k) applied against the pilot.

We can accept either option. A few operational clarifications:
- If they choose the credit cushion route, request a wire or ACH clearing before we provision beyond the first milestone. We will mark that as an advance and apply it to invoices automatically.
- For Net45 approvals, finance wants a one-time credit threshold for this account of USD 50,000 so the switching to Net30 after two invoices doesn't require a separate approval. That limit is conservative given their forecast.
- Laura: if legal can confirm the SOW includes standard payment remedy language (late fee window, invoice dispute timeline), we can greenlight Net45 with the 50k threshold.

Irene — I can approve this today if their finance team confirms PO and deposit/credit method.

Thanks,
Marcus
Finance Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Irene / Marcus / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear playbook. Per our finance call this morning: 

- Medisupply can accept the conditional Net45 for invoices 1 and 2, moving to Net30 after the pilot as proposed.
- We'll provide a 15% milestone deposit on invoice 1 (can do 15% instead of 10% to expedite provisioning). Expect the wire to be initiated 24–48 hours after DocuSign is completed.
- We'll send the PO by end of day Monday and upload our signed Tax Residency and VAT evidence to your shared drive.

I will initiate the DocuSign SOW link now and copy you on completion.

Attachment: DocuSign-SOW-Redwood-MediSupply.pdf (docusign link)
